tests.title: Course page only lets customers book upcoming sessions and books the chosen one
tests.goal: Past session dates cannot be chosen, and the enrolment is on the date the customer picked.
preconditions: A visible QA course with a weekly Fixed timetable
data: QA course 3200 or another found at runtime

steps.text: Open the course page on the eShop
Click a past session date in the calendar (shown with is_passed)
Pick the timeslot and click Apply
Check out (Bank Transfer) and open the enrolment in the CRM Status List

expected.text: Past dates are disabled, or Apply is refused with a message
If a date is accepted, the enrolment and cart show that same date

checks.label: Past dates are disabled, or Apply is refused with a message

notes: Logged in as the QA member, course 3200 (timetable 70). Real pointer clicks on past Wednesdays 7/14/21 Oct do nothing: Timeslots stays "Please select a date" (CSS pointer-events: none on .circle.active.is_passed; styles.css last modified 27 Oct 02:53 GMT, before the original report). No date accepted, so no order placed and the second expectation does not apply. The 27 Oct fail came from automation clicks that bypass CSS; BUG-014 withdrawn.
Re-check of BUG-014 (course past session date).
